situations.title: 통역 서비스 요청·활용
situations.tagline: My mother doesn't speak English — how can we understand each other?
situations.brief: 공식 통역 서비스를 요청하고 활용해 정확한 소통을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get a professional interpreter for us right away.
Please speak naturally and I'll speak to your mother directly.
The interpreter will make sure nothing gets lost.

situations.title: 삽관 환자 비언어 소통
situations.tagline: 삽관으로 말을 못 하는 환자가 무언가를 애타게 전하려 손짓한다.
situations.brief: 보드와 제스처를 활용해 삽관 환자와 비언어적으로 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: You can't talk with the tube, so let's use this board.
Point to what you need and I'll help.
Blink twice for yes, once for no — is that okay?
goals: 소통 보드와 제스처로 환자의 요구를 파악한다

situations.title: 진정 환자 의사표현 확인
situations.tagline: 진정 상태의 환자가 자극에 눈을 뜨며 희미하게 반응한다.
situations.brief: 진정 환자의 반응을 해석해 의사표현과 편안함을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you squeeze my hand if you hear me?
I'm checking if you're comfortable right now.
Open your eyes for me if you can.
goals: 진정 환자의 반응을 사정해 의사표현을 확인한다

situations.title: 언어장벽 통증 사정
situations.tagline: 말이 통하지 않는 환자가 얼굴을 찌푸리며 통증을 호소한다.
situations.brief: 그림 척도를 활용해 언어장벽이 있는 환자의 통증을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Point to the face that shows how much it hurts.
Zero is no pain, ten is the worst pain.
Show me where it hurts on your body.

situations.title: 간단 지시·설명 명확화
situations.tagline: Please — say it slower, I want to understand what you need me to do.
situations.brief: plain language를 사용해 간단한 지시와 설명을 명확히 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll say it slowly and use simple words.
Take a deep breath in — like this.
Nod if that makes sense to you.
goals: 쉬운 표현으로 지시와 설명을 명확히 전달한다

situations.title: 가족 통한 기본 정보 확인
situations.tagline: I can tell you what my father usually takes, if that helps.
situations.brief: 가족을 통해 기본 정보를 확인하되 한계와 주의점을 유념하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you — can you tell me his medications and allergies?
For medical details, we'll confirm with an interpreter.
This helps us keep him safe right now.

situations.title: 삽관 환자 예·아니오 소통
situations.tagline: 삽관 환자가 답답한 표정으로 눈을 깜빡이며 반응하려 한다.
situations.brief: 확립된 예·아니오 신호로 삽관 환자와 안정적으로 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's agree — one blink for yes, two for no.
Are you in pain? Blink once if yes.
You're doing great, let's keep using our signals.

situations.title: 통역 통한 동의·설명
situations.tagline: Through the interpreter — I want to fully understand before I sign anything.
situations.brief: 통역을 통해 informed 소통으로 동의와 설명을 정확히 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: The interpreter will explain the procedure fully.
Please ask any questions before you decide.
Can you tell me in your words what you understood?
goals: 통역을 통해 동의 내용을 정확히 설명한다

situations.title: 문화적 표현·금기 고려
situations.tagline: In our culture, we don't speak of death directly — please be mindful.
situations.brief: 문화 감수성을 가지고 문화적 표현과 금기를 고려해 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for telling me — I'll be respectful of that.
How would you like me to talk about his condition?
Please guide me on what's appropriate for your family.

situations.title: 가족 통역 한계·공식 통역 전환
situations.tagline: It's okay if I translate for my dad, right? I've always done it.
situations.brief: 가족 통역의 한계를 설명하고 정확성을 위해 공식 통역으로 전환하세요.
keyPhrases: You've been a great help, and I'm grateful.
For medical decisions, we use a trained interpreter for accuracy.
This protects your father and takes the burden off you.

situations.title: 청각·시각 장애 병행 소통
situations.tagline: My husband is hard of hearing and can barely see — how will he know what's happening?
situations.brief: 보조수단을 활용해 청각·시각 장애가 병행된 환자와 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: We can use his hearing aids and a large-print board.
I'll face him and speak clearly on his better side.
Touch and simple signals will help him feel oriented.

situations.title: 통역 통한 목표설정 대화
situations.tagline: Through the interpreter, we need to talk about what happens if he doesn't improve.
situations.brief: 통역을 통해 복잡한 목표설정 대화를 정확하고 민감하게 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: The interpreter will convey everything carefully.
Let's talk about what matters most to him.
Please take your time — there's no rush.
goals: 통역을 통해 목표설정 대화를 정확히 전달한다

situations.title: 다국어 약물·안전 교육
situations.tagline: I want to give his medicines right at home — can you make sure I understand?
situations.brief: 이해 확인을 중심으로 다국어 약물·안전 교육을 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: Here's the medication list in your language.
Show me how you'd give this dose.
Tell me back when you'd call the doctor.

situations.title: 원격 통역 활용
situations.tagline: Can we use one of those video interpreter machines? My mom would feel better.
situations.brief: 전화·영상 통역 장비를 설치하고 흐름을 관리해 원격 통역을 활용하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll bring the video interpreter to the bedside.
Let's position the screen so she can see clearly.
I'll pause so the interpreter can keep up.
goals: 통역 흐름을 관리해 정확한 소통을 유지한다

situations.title: 소통 오류 확인·재확립
situations.tagline: I think we misunderstood something earlier — can we go over it again?
situations.brief: teach-back으로 소통 오류를 확인하고 정확한 이해를 재확립하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's make sure we're both on the same page.
Can you tell me back what you understood?
I'll clarify that part so there's no confusion.

situations.title: 급변 중 언어장벽 위기 소통
situations.tagline: Que está pasando? Please — what is happening to her?!
situations.brief: 급변 상황에서 언어장벽을 넘어 신속히 핵심을 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: She's having trouble breathing and we're helping her now.
The interpreter phone is coming — stay with me.
We're doing everything to keep her safe.

situations.title: 나쁜 소식 통역 상황
situations.tagline: Please tell the interpreter to be gentle when you say this to my mother.
situations.brief: 민감함과 정확성을 유지하며 통역을 통해 나쁜 소식을 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: The interpreter will convey this gently and completely.
I'm so sorry to share difficult news.
Take all the time you need — we're here with you.
goals: 통역을 통해 나쁜 소식을 정확히 전달한다

situations.title: 임종 결정 언어장벽
situations.tagline: Through the interpreter — how do we decide this for him if we can't ask him?
situations.brief: 대리 결정과 통역 윤리를 지키며 언어장벽 속 임종 결정을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: The interpreter will make sure every word is clear.
Let's decide based on what he would have wanted.
We'll support you through this decision together.
goals: 통역을 통해 임종 결정 논의를 정확히 진행한다
대리 결정 원칙을 지키며 가족을 지원한다

situations.title: 동의 능력·언어 혼재 판단
situations.tagline: He mixes languages when he's confused — is he really able to decide right now?
situations.brief: 언어 혼재 상황에서 capacity 소통으로 동의 능력을 신중히 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll use an interpreter to assess him fairly.
Capacity depends on understanding, not just language.
Let's see if he can explain the choice back to us.
goals: 통역을 활용해 동의 능력을 공정히 사정한다

situations.title: 통역 부재 응급 대응
situations.tagline: 통역이 즉시 오지 못하는 응급 상황에서 환자가 겁에 질려 몸을 뒤척인다.
situations.brief: 통역 부재 응급에서 임시 수단으로 최소한의 안전 소통을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm using the phone interpreter line right now.
Point to this picture board to tell me what you feel.
You're safe — I'm staying right here with you.
goals: 통역 부재 시 임시 수단으로 소통을 시도한다

situations.title: 문화 갈등·치료 거부 소통
situations.tagline: Our beliefs don't allow that treatment — please don't force it on him.
situations.brief: 중재와 존중을 바탕으로 문화 갈등과 치료 거부 상황을 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I respect your beliefs and want to understand them.
Let's find an approach that honors your values and his safety.
The interpreter and ethics team can help us find common ground.
